lines.text: Bildad the Shuhite replies to Job and tells him to show some sense, and then they can talk.
Bildad asks if the rocks should be moved on Job's account, and says the lamp of the wicked goes out.
The wicked man's own feet lead him into a net, and a trap seizes his heel.
The wicked man is torn from the shelter of his tent and marched off to the king of Babylon.
The roots beneath him dry up, and those in the north are appalled at his fate.
